messages:
omar: hey team :wave: first week — trying to get the sample infra PR to pass. Buildkite step that calls GitHub Actions via repo_dispatch returns 403 Forbidden: 

```
2024-11-01T09:12:03Z ERROR POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/telemetry/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

I can see the repo and the pipeline in the org. who owns the Buildkite GitHub App install? @tiff

tiff: welcome aboard! :tada: that 403 almost always means the GitHub App token doesn't have access to that repo or the app isn't installed there. can you paste the pipeline step that does the dispatch?

omar: here's the exact step from infra/pipelines/telemetry.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -s -X POST \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
      -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/telemetry/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \
      -d '{\"ref\":\"main\"}'
```

omar: Buildkite injects GITHUB_TOKEN into the job env.

infra-bot: scanning org installs... Buildkite GitHub App present with "selected repositories" mode. Repo `telemetry` not in allowed list. tagging @ops-ryan to add repo.

ops-ryan: added `telemetry` to Buildkite app allowed repos. changes should propagate in ~30s. re-run the job when you're ready.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/778 re-run requested by ops-ryan

omar: re-ran and the repo_dispatch now returns 204, GitHub Actions queued. thanks!! :raised_hands:

tiff: nice. onboarding action: please open a tiny PR to infra/permissions.md documenting repos that need Buildkite app access for repo_dispatch, and move the curl into scripts/dispatch.sh that logs HTTP status for debugging.

omar: will do. quick follow-ups: 1) how do I request membership in `ci-admins`? 2) where's the runbook about re-runs and artifacts?

ops-ryan: request team invites via #people-ops. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/buildkite-runbook and https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/artifacts.

omar: great — thanks for the quick help, everyone :heart: I’ll open the PR and ping you on it.
